RYA-963 telluric-corrected sibling of alpha_cen_a_crires_plus; alpha_cen_a_crires_plus itself is UNMODIFIED. 6 CRIRES+ EXTRACTC IDPs from 2022-04-15 (one per setting: Y1029, J1232, H1582, H1559, K2192, K2148), corrected with ESO molecfit (molecfit_model on derived fit windows, then molecfit_calctrans over every chip) against the REAL per-night Paranal GDAS profile 2022-04-15T03 - all 6 exposures fall in the same 3-hourly slot, and no standard-atmosphere fallback is in play (the RYA-373 failure mode). ONE atmosphere is fitted per exposure and evaluated over all chips: one exposure saw one sky, so a per-chip independent fit would let the water column disagree with itself inside a single 4-second exposure. THE FIT IS PROVEN TO HAVE MOVED, not merely to have exited 0: molecfit reports success and writes every product even when mpfit takes its status-4 exit with a zero Jacobian, leaving each column at its prior with uncertainty exactly 0 and transmission 1.0 everywhere - an uncorrected spectrum wearing a correction's provenance. Two distinct causes produced exactly that here and both are now asserted against: WLC_CONST is a FRACTION of the chip's half wavelength range, so its -0.05 default is -3.4 A on a 134 A chip but -135 A on a whole 540 nm setting handed over as one chip; and without MAP_REGIONS_TO_CHIP molecfit says 'Assuming that all regions are mapped to Chip 1' and puts every fit window on the first chip. Fit windows are DERIVED per frame (the unsaturated, non-stellar absorbed fraction per chip), not tabulated, and the stellar exclusion mask comes from linelist_solar rather than hand-listed wavelengths. Molecules are split: the MODEL carries every molecule with a band in the frame (or calctrans would leave that absorber out entirely), while only those with a band inside a fit window are FITTED. D1 residual gate, at telluric-dominated stellar-clean pixels, before->after: Y1029 0.2143->0.0298; J1232 0.2239->0.0389; H1582 0.2166->0.0286; H1559 0.2207->0.0192; K2192 0.1792->0.0171; K2148 0.1370->0.0277. Fitted PWV (mm): Y1029 0.791; J1232 0.809; H1582 0.770; H1559 0.793; K2192 0.732; K2148 0.757.
